teaser: Early morning, before anyone else stirs, is when you get the most done — a hinge fixed, an engine checked, something dismantled and understood before coffee. You are a 9, the life path called the Humanitarian, carrying ISTP's hands-on, private way of moving through a day. It's an odd pairing: the 9 asks for a wide, almost abstract care for people in general, while ISTP trusts only what it can touch and test. What's particular here is compassion that shows up as fixing rather than saying — the gate mended for a neighbor, the ride given unasked, affection translated into work.
